name: Do I need an engineer to remove a wall for an open-concept remodel?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an engineer to remove a wall for an open-concept remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if the wall you plan to remove is load-bearing, you will absolutely need a structural engineer. A load-bearing wall supports the weight of the structure above it, and its removal without proper support can compromise your home's integrity. An engineer will assess the wall's function and design a suitable support solution, such as a new beam or column. Even for non-load-bearing walls, an engineer might be consulted if there are complex structural elements or if the renovation impacts multiple levels. Always consult a professional before removing any interior wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need a structural engineer if the wall is load-bearing to ensure your home's structural integrity. Always consult a professional before removing any interior wall.
